>secret service ignores MANY signs/warnings

>small town rally being televised (these rallies are not normally televised)
>Pulitzer Prize winning photographer present
>tiny women agents not big enough to even cover/protect Trump
>federal agencies find no addition info on shooter after days of searches and seizures

All signs point to this shooting being a failed deep state assassination attempt, carried out by fed-picked patsy.

The deep state hates Donald Trump. The deep state fears Donald Trump. He’s an outsider. They don’t control him. They wanted to shatter Trump’s skull in 4K while the whole world watched.
